summary: PVH Corp. filed an 8-K to declare a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.0375 per share, payable on June 24, 2026 to holders of record on June 3, 2026. This is an ordinary capital return action by the issuer, not a special situation. The filing contains no unusual event, such as a change of control, activist campaign, strategic review, or structural change. No transaction terms, premium, or advisors are mentioned. The filing consists solely of the dividend declaration and an attached press release. What to watch: none; this is a routine dividend announcement with no risk-arb angle.
